in_marathi.name: Amey
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amey हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Amrut' meaning 'nectar of immortality'. In Hindu mythology, 'Amey' is a name given to various gods and goddesses.

vedic_reference.note: The name Amey is derived from the Sanskrit word अमेय (Amey) which means 'Imperishable, Unchangeable'. It is a name that evokes a sense of strength, resilience, and the power of the eternal. While the name is not explicitly mentioned in any Vedic texts, it is a name that resonates with the values and ideals of ancient Indian wisdom.
